message.content: The diagram is presented on **one continuous, scrollable sheet** rather than in separate boxes. The section headers, such as "1 · FEED & REFORMING" and "2 · SHIFT & PURIFICATION," function as **internal captions** placed directly onto the canvas to delineate different stages of the process. There are **no visible text overlap or clipping issues**; all labels for equipment (e.g., K-102, E-104), stream numbers, and flow directions are clearly legible and well-spaced within the dark-mode interface.
